question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Cash runs ahead of reported earnings. Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} against net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}, so operating cash flow over net income reads {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}; the sign is negative only because earnings are a loss while cash is positive. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct}: earnings sit below cash. Against its own history the company turned from consuming operating cash, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow} in the year to March 2025, to producing it, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow} in the year to March 2026; annual accruals over total assets were {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, and the quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} a year earlier, almost unchanged. Only two years and two quarters are filled, and the older calendar years predate a change of fiscal year and the MiX Telematics and Fleet Complete acquisitions, so the long history is not like-for-like. The wedge between cash and earnings is mainly non-cash amortization of acquired intangibles inside depreciation and amortization of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}, not working capital. Working capital absorbed cash over the year: receivables changed by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, inventory by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} and payables by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, taking trade working capital from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now}; receivables did the absorbing. In the quarter the combined payables-and-accruals line supplied far less cash than a year earlier, so the year-over-year rise in operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} did not come from stretching suppliers. Articulation: the cash-flow statement charges receivables growth of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change} over the trailing four quarters, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} to the balance sheet; inventory's gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. Both point the way a bad-debt provision and an inventory reserve charge added back on their own lines would push them, net of currency translation and acquired RTS balances, but no bridge is in the input, so both stay unresolved. Payables articulation cannot be computed because the company tags only a combined payables, accrued expenses and other liabilities line. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, above one: income moves more than cash, so earnings are not smoothed. Earnings were bunched into the derived fiscal fourth quarter of fiscal 2026: its operating income of {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter.inputs.before} is larger than the nine months before it combined, {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter.inputs.before.parts.1}, while operating cash flow in that quarter, {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.1}, was flat against the quarter before, {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2}; this quarter's operating income of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter} then fell by {ratios.growth.operating_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}. The spike sat in accrual earnings and its cause is not in the input. Two items flatter the cash picture: operating cash flow includes invoiced recoveries of the contract asset acquired with Fleet Complete for hardware delivered before the acquisition, a balance running off rather than a recurring source; and cash paid to develop software sits in investing outside the calculator's capital expenditure, so free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} overstates what is left after development spending, while the release's own free cash flow for the quarter, which deducts it, is negative. Neither amount is a field in calculator_filings_only.json, so no adjustment is written; share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} is already deducted in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Reported cash backs reported earnings: accruals are negative and earnings are not smoothed. Cash quality is modestly flattered by run-off recoveries of an acquired contract asset and by development spending kept outside capital expenditure, and fourth-quarter operating income was not matched by cash; none of these is quantified in the input.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue in the latest quarter, and the disclosure that would anchor them was removed. Days sales outstanding are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the second highest of six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier; receivables over quarterly revenue moved from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, while quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. Part of the receivables growth is acquired RTS balances and rand translation, which the input does not separate. The annual view runs the other way, from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and the highest quarter on record, {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, is the oldest filled one, so this is a recent rise inside a range. The revenue note no longer states that payment terms are generally thirty days; receivable days sat far above that in every filled quarter, and nothing replaces the statement. No extended payment terms or bill-and-hold appear in the input. Contract liabilities do not move against revenue: current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, the highest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, and MD&A reports deferred revenue up slightly, so revenue is not being drawn out of deferred balances. Policy wording changed in three places: subscription revenue now starts when services are made available rather than at customer acknowledgement of acceptance, an earlier start read literally, while MD&A says critical policies did not change significantly; product revenue is now recognized typically upon shipment or delivery, in a quarter whose product revenue turned on late-quarter shipments; and the sales-type lease revenue policy was removed. Principal-versus-agent and standalone-selling-price text is carried over, so no new judgment area. Product revenue fell year over year and also fell for fiscal 2026, so the decline predates this quarter's production delays. Fourth-quarter concentration: the derived fiscal fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 carried revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter.inputs.before}, above this quarter by a sequential change of {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct}; the sharper bunching is in operating income, under earnings versus cash. RTS revenue sits inside the year-over-year growth and the release reports no organic figure.
revenue_recognition.verdict: No sign in the numbers that revenue is pulled forward: deferred revenue is up and product revenue is down. But receivable days are near the top of the company's range, the payment-terms statement was removed, and two recognition-timing sentences were reworded toward earlier recognition without being called a change. Watch, not yet adverse.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Several estimates moved in the income-raising direction in the same quarter, none quantified. Warranty: the accrual over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, the lowest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier; the balance is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}, and the annual ratio fell from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, while warranties issued rose and MD&A reports production delays and firmware compatibility problems with new components. The roll-forward showing whether the reduction went to income is not in the input. Useful lives: technology moved from three-to-five years to five-to-seven and software to be sold from three-to-five to three-to-seven, with no change in estimate disclosed; reported intangible amortization still rose year over year, so translation and new software hide the effect. Commissions are now amortized over an estimated period of benefit rather than the contract term while deferred costs rose. Prepayment derivative: the Level three asset rose and a non-cash gain entered net income; the key-input table was relabelled from credit spread volatility to risk-free interest rate volatility while the tags still name credit spreads, and the restated sensitivities say both an upward and a downward shock raise the asset. Credit losses: the quarterly allowance ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, third lowest of six and slightly below {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}; the annual ratio rose from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} after an unexplained step-up a year ago; write-offs exceeded a rising provision this quarter, so credit losses are a growing recurring cost, not a release. A new practical expedient assumes reporting-date conditions persist, called not material, while the policy text still mentions expected future changes. Inventory reserve: no ratio for any recent period, only {trend_table.quarters-back-6.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} in the two oldest filled quarters, and the release's larger reserve charge is untagged. Tax: trailing tax of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} on pre-tax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}; foreign profits are taxed while United States losses add to a growing valuation allowance, with no release or discrete benefit, so tax is not raising income. Goodwill moved only by translation and no impairment indicator was found in the quarter the release revises guidance and forgoes South African revenue; headroom, discount-rate and growth assumptions are not in the input. New judgment areas: a provisional RTS purchase price allocation and a redeemable non-controlling interest measured by Monte Carlo.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Adverse lean. The warranty reserve is at its low, useful-life ranges lengthened without disclosure, commission amortization moved to a longer basis and a Level three derivative gain rests on relabelled inputs, all income-raising; the credit-loss allowance and tax accounts are not flattering earnings. No income effect is in calculator_filings_only.json, so no adjustment can be written.

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalized cost is rising against its expensed equivalent. In the quarter expensed research and development fell year over year while the release shows total development cost incurred and the capitalized portion both rose; MD&A attributes the lower expense to more employee hours on projects that qualify for capitalization, and gross capitalized software and cash paid to develop software both grew. Trailing expensed research and development is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}. Paired with the longer useful-life range for software to be sold, this lifts current operating income and moves cost into later amortization. The record tags no capitalized software additions, the release's capitalized figure does not bridge to the tagged software cash outflow, and calculator_filings_only.json has no field for either, so no adjustment can be written. Deferred contract costs rose again under a longer amortization basis. Soft assets are stable at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of assets, third lowest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year earlier. Non-recurring items recur: restructuring charges have appeared in every period since April 2024 and more severance is expected within twelve months, the restructuring policy text was removed, the release's restructuring-related add-back is larger than the tagged charge in both quarters with no bridge, and acquisition-related costs are added back by a company that acquires repeatedly. The non-GAAP gap is not computed by the calculator; in the release the adjusted net result moved down while the GAAP net loss narrowed, so the gap narrowed this quarter, and the adjusted EBITDA definition was tightened by dropping the Fleet Complete contract-asset add-back with comparatives recast. The release's non-GAAP sales and marketing expense is larger than the tagged segment figure in both quarters, unexplained.
cost_deferral.verdict: Adverse lean on development cost: capitalization rises while expensed research and development falls, and restructuring recurs as an add-back. Soft assets are flat and the non-GAAP definition was tightened, not loosened.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: nothing found; no proceeds from sale of receivables are tagged in any period and no text mentions a programme. Supplier finance: nothing found in tags or text. Purchase obligations: nothing found, which for a hardware supplier means undisclosed in this input, not shown to be zero. Guarantees: no maximum exposure is tagged, and the prior filing's description of joint and several guarantees and second-priority share security behind the new RMB revolvers was dropped. Variable-interest entities: nothing found. Leases are on balance sheet, the operating lease liability at {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability}. Classification: operating cash flow includes shrinking recoveries of the pre-acquisition Fleet Complete contract asset; software development payments are investing cash, deducted in the release's free cash flow but not in the calculator's; and the debt note tags Hapoalim term proceeds and a prepayment to this quarter while the cash-flow statement shows no proceeds line and the calculator finds no debt issued, {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}, leaving open whether the refinancing was non-cash or belongs to another period. RTS was paid for with an interest in the MiX Africa subsidiary, so its cost never touches the acquisitions line, {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}; the seller holds a put after the fifth anniversary at the greater of a revenue formula or a rand floor, a contingent cash obligation carried as temporary equity, not debt. The RMB General Facility is past its stated repayment date, shown as on demand with no written extension, and its undrawn amount is counted in the capacity the release cites. Net short-term borrowing supplied {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_short_term_net} over the trailing four quarters, financing cash rather than operating. Share-based compensation is a real cost though no cash leaves: {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters, {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_revenue|pct} of revenue and {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of operating cash flow, rising after new restricted and performance unit grants; it is already deducted in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No factoring or supplier finance is visible. Operating cash is modestly lifted by run-off recoveries of an acquired asset; the share-paid RTS acquisition and its put sit outside free cash flow; guarantee and security disclosure was thinned.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The backdrop is weak. The 8-K index the numbers reader carried without paragraph ids shows a non-reliance filing in April 2024, auditor-change filings in July and August 2024, listing-deficiency notices during 2024 and late-filing notices, the latest for the annual report in June 2025; nothing later is on the late-filing list. A 10-Q carries no auditor report, and no material weakness or auditor change appears in this period's input. The chief financial officer was replaced with the results by a strategic finance advisor to the company, the outgoing CFO stays as a consultant, further officer-change filings in May and July 2026 have no body in the input, and a Chief AI Officer came from an advisory role. The controls item reports no change in internal control for the quarter, which can hold if the changes fall after quarter end. Quiet changes to prior-period text: the Hapoalim modification proceeds and carrying-value increase differ from the prior filing with no correction flagged, the RTS closing date moved, and one restructuring figure is tagged to a full year in the 10-Q and to nine months in the 10-K; no tagged value was re-reported differently. Internal inconsistencies are dense: the maturity schedule shows nothing for the rest of fiscal 2027 though current maturities exist and Facility A amortizes quarterly, its year labels appear shifted, and the amortizing Hapoalim loan is labelled non-current; the EPS note still names preferred stock as the participating security after redemption; a director-affiliate warrant vests from a date before issue; a performance-award fair value changes with no activity; derivative input labels disagree with the tags. Tagging errors repeat: a financing-cost amortization in the prior quarterly report above the facility's face amount, facility amounts in both rand and dollars, shekel units on dollar carrying amounts, one compensation figure under three award types, and re-tagged software and intangibles. The Pointer Brazil tax notice, the restructuring policy and several Hapoalim terms were dropped without stated resolution. The release ties the non-GAAP change to SEC guidance while the 10-Q says only further review; no comment letter or subsidiary-list exhibit is in the input.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: Adverse. A recent history of non-reliance, auditor change and late filing, a CFO replaced at the results, and many internal inconsistencies and tagging errors in this filing point to strained financial reporting, though no material weakness is stated in the input.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Every notes item with an expected direction is reconciled below, with the main direction-free items the numbers can test. Most this-quarter items are confirmed; guidance, bookings and customer claims are unresolved because no filed number reaches them. The numbers contradict the notes where reported intangible amortization rose although longer useful lives would lower it, where short-term bank loans fell although the RMB revolver draw implies a rise, where the accounts payable balance fell although MD&A reports an increase, where MD&A treats other non-cash items as an addition the statement deducts, where the maturity schedule's empty year conflicts with quarterly amortization and the stated maturities, and where derivative input labels conflict with the tags. Does the 8-K release match the 10-Q? On hard figures, yes: operating cash flow, capital expenditure, software payments and free cash flow are built from the tagged facts, bad-debt expense matches, total debt matches the carrying amount in the fair value table, and cash plus capacity matches stated liquidity. On framing, no: the CEO says operating cash flow nearly doubled while the computed growth is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}, matching the release's own highlight and short of a doubling; the release calls the production problem discrete, solved and sized while the 10-Q gives no amount and no assurance; the South African reprioritization, forgone revenue and guidance revision appear nowhere in the 10-Q; the release says South African revenue was lower while the 10-Q's Africa line rose, with no baseline named; the release's capitalized development, restructuring-related and non-GAAP sales and marketing figures do not bridge to tagged amounts; and full-year net loss guidance sits below the first quarter's own loss. Pipeline point: the calculator's total debt, {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, is above the release's figure because short-term borrowings already include current maturities, per the numbers reader, so net debt {ratios.solvency.net_debt} and debt over EBITDA {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda} should not be taken at face value.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The release's cash and debt figures match the 10-Q, but the release frames the quarter more favourably than the 10-Q in several places and the 10-Q's own MD&A mislabels two cash-flow lines; the contradictions stand.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: no build-up; inventory days are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the lowest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} at the top, and raw materials fell. The risk is forward: MD&A describes component transitions with firmware incompatibility that can strand older parts, the release's reserve charge rose and is untagged, and no reserve ratio exists for any recent period. Purchase commitments in excess of need: nothing found, as none is tagged or described; not shown to be zero. Customer concentration: nothing found in the record, since concentration facts are empty; the National Treasury deployment in South Africa is growing into a large share of new recurring revenue while the company forgoes other South African revenue to serve it, a prospective dependence on one government customer the filing does not measure. Channel stuffing: nothing found; product revenue and inventory fell while deferred revenue rose, the opposite of loading the channel, though product recognition now reads typically upon shipment and the quarter turned on late shipments. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found; the company invests in no customer in the input, and RTS was bought from Macrocomm for a subsidiary stake with a put, with no sign Macrocomm buys from the company.
industry_lens.verdict: Clean on inventory and channel loading; concentration and purchase commitments cannot be measured from the tagged record, and component-transition risk sits against an unmeasured inventory reserve.

anomalies.name: Receivable days near the top of the range
anomalies.what: Days sales outstanding of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} are the second highest of six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and receivables over revenue rose from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}; MD&A gives no cause. The annual figure fell, so this is a recent rise inside the range.

anomalies.name: Payment-terms statement removed
anomalies.what: The prior filing said payment terms are generally thirty days after invoice; the sentence is gone. Receivable days of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} on the trailing average, sit far above such terms, as in every filled quarter, so stated terms and numbers disagreed before the sentence was dropped and nothing replaces it.

anomalies.name: Subscription start point reworded earlier
anomalies.name_ko: 구독 매출 인식 시작 시점 문구 변경
anomalies.what: Subscription revenue now begins when services are made available, where the removed text began it at customer acknowledgement of acceptance, while MD&A says critical policies did not change significantly. Service revenue rose, but contract liabilities over revenue reached {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, not what a pull-forward would produce; the effect cannot be isolated.

anomalies.name: Product recognition reworded to shipment
anomalies.name_ko: 제품 매출 인식 시점 문구 변경
anomalies.what: Product revenue is now recognized typically upon shipment or delivery, replacing text tied to delivery of the system once obligations were met, in a quarter whose product revenue turned on late-quarter shipments. Fiscal 2026 product revenue had already fallen, so the decline is not only timing.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities at their highest against revenue
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, the highest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}; the balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}. MD&A's small deferred revenue increase agrees; part of the rise is lower quarterly revenue.

anomalies.name: Lease revenue policy removed
anomalies.what: The sales-type and operating lease revenue policy was removed and leasing is mentioned only as arising to a lesser extent; sales-type leases recognize product revenue at commencement, so a recognition choice is no longer described. No lease-receivable figure is in the input.

anomalies.name: Acquired revenue inside reported growth
anomalies.what: RTS, acquired in February 2026, contributes revenue with no counterpart in the prior-year quarter, so part of the year-over-year growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} is bought; the release defines organic growth but reports none, and the pro forma prior-year figure is a rounded single number.

anomalies.name: Warranty reserve at its low while product risk rises
anomalies.what: The warranty accrual over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, the lowest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}; the balance fell from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual} to {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual}. Warranties issued rose and MD&A describes production delays and firmware problems with new components. A thinner reserve against rising risk is income-raising; no field carries a release amount.

anomalies.name: Useful-life ranges lengthened without disclosure
anomalies.what: Technology moved from three-to-five years to five-to-seven and software to be sold from three-to-five to three-to-seven, with no text and no disclosed change in estimate, while MD&A says critical policies did not change significantly. Longer lives lower amortization, yet reported intangible amortization rose year over year; the own effect cannot be isolated, but the reported direction is opposite.

anomalies.name: Write-offs exceed a rising provision
anomalies.what: Write-offs rose year over year and exceeded the quarter's provision, which also rose; the allowance ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, third lowest of six. Credit losses are a growing recurring cost, not a release, and MD&A's charge agrees with the provision.

anomalies.name: Allowance stepped up with no stated driver
anomalies.what: The allowance stood at {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year ago, after a much lower balance at the end of fiscal 2025, and the annual ratio rose from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}; whether acquisition accounting or a change in estimate drove it is not in the input.

anomalies.name: Credit-loss expedient against policy text
anomalies.what: From the start of fiscal 2027 the company assumes reporting-date conditions persist for the life of receivables, called not material and prospective, while the allowance policy still describes considering expected future changes. The expedient can only lower forward-looking provisioning; its effect is unquantified.

anomalies.name: Level three derivative gain on relabelled inputs
anomalies.what: The prepayment derivative rose and a non-cash gain entered GAAP net income against a loss a year earlier. The input table now says risk-free interest rate volatility where the tags still say credit spread, and the restated sensitivities say both an upward and a downward shock raise the asset. The gain is excluded from adjusted EBITDA but raises reported earnings; no field carries it.

anomalies.name: No impairment indicator despite reprioritization
anomalies.what: Goodwill moved only by translation and the note finds no impairment indicator in the quarter the release revises guidance and forgoes South African revenue; Africa goodwill includes RTS. Headroom, discount-rate and growth assumptions are not in the input.

anomalies.name: Inventory reserve cannot be measured
anomalies.what: No inventory reserve ratio exists for any recent period; the only values, {trend_table.quarters-back-6.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct}, come from the two oldest filled quarters and are far apart. The release and MD&A give a larger reserve charge than a year earlier, but no tag or balance carries it.

anomalies.name: Tax expense on a pre-tax loss
anomalies.what: The quarterly effective rate is more negative than a year earlier because foreign profits are taxed while United States losses add to a growing valuation allowance; trailing tax is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} on pre-tax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}. No release or discrete benefit lifts earnings, and no rate-driver text explains the change.

anomalies.name: Commission amortization moved to period of benefit
anomalies.what: Capitalized commissions are now amortized over an estimated period of benefit rather than the contract term, while deferred costs rose again; a longer period defers expense, and no amount is given.

anomalies.name: New judgment areas from the RTS deal
anomalies.name_ko: RTS 인수 관련 새 판단 영역
anomalies.what: The RTS purchase price allocation is provisional until early 2027, the redeemable non-controlling interest is valued by Monte Carlo and remeasured to redemption value, and an ownership rebalancing was booked to paid-in capital rather than income; each can move equity or earnings later without cash.

anomalies.name: Capitalized development rising as expensed R&D falls
anomalies.what: Expensed research and development fell year over year while the release shows total cost and the capitalized portion both rose; MD&A attributes it to more hours on qualifying projects, and capitalized software and software payments grew. Trailing expensed R&D is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}. No field carries the capitalized amount and the release's figure does not bridge to the tagged cash outflow.

anomalies.name: Recurring restructuring added back
anomalies.what: Restructuring charges have recurred every period since April 2024 and more severance is expected, yet they are added back as non-recurring; the release's restructuring-related add-back is larger than the tagged charge in both quarters with no bridge, and the policy on reassessment and reversals was removed.

anomalies.name: Adjusted EBITDA definition tightened
anomalies.what: Adjusted EBITDA no longer adds back the pre-acquisition Fleet Complete contract asset, with comparatives recast and the excluded amounts printed separately: a conservative change from the company's past. The release links it to SEC guidance, the 10-Q only to further review.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP gap narrowed
anomalies.what: The calculator cannot compute the gap because no tag carries a non-GAAP figure; in the release adjusted net income moved from a profit to a loss while the GAAP net loss narrowed, so the gap narrowed this quarter, while the tax effect of adjustments grew.

anomalies.name: Hapoalim proceeds tagged but absent from cash flow
anomalies.what: The debt note tags Hapoalim term proceeds, a prepayment of the prior facilities and a net increase to this quarter, but the cash-flow statement shows no proceeds line and the calculator finds no debt issued, {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}; the prior filing gave larger figures for the same modification. Non-cash modification, misplaced period or misclassification is not settled.

anomalies.name: Share-paid acquisition with a cash put
anomalies.what: RTS was paid for with an interest in MiX Africa, so its cost bypasses the acquisitions line, {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}, and free cash flow. After the fifth anniversary the seller can require a purchase at the greater of a revenue formula or a rand floor, or take company shares: a contingent cash obligation carried as temporary equity. The empowerment purpose stated earlier was dropped.

anomalies.name: Guarantee and security disclosure removed
anomalies.what: The prior description of joint and several guarantees, second-priority share security and an accession requirement behind the new RMB revolvers is absent from the current note, and no guarantee exposure is tagged in any period.

anomalies.name: Overdue on-demand facility counted as capacity
anomalies.name_ko: 만기 지난 요구불 한도의 가용한도 포함
anomalies.what: The RMB General Facility was due by its stated date before this quarter unless extended; it is still drawn and shown on demand with no written extension or waiver, only the lender's indication it will not demand repayment and a replacement awaiting documents. Its undrawn amount sits in the capacity the release cites, and its amounts carry both rand and dollar units.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation rose year over year after new restricted and performance unit grants; trailing it is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_operating_cash_flow|pct} of operating cash flow, a real cost already deducted in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. One figure is tagged under three award types, so the split is unknown.

anomalies.name: CFO replaced at the results
anomalies.what: The CFO was replaced by a strategic finance advisor to the company, the outgoing CFO stays as a consultant, other officer-change filings in May and July 2026 have no body in the input, and the company has a non-reliance filing, auditor changes and late-filing notices in 2024 and 2025. The controls item reports no change in internal control, which may hold if the changes fall after quarter end.

anomalies.name: Debt maturity schedule inconsistent
anomalies.what: The schedule shows nothing due for the rest of fiscal 2027 though current maturities are tagged and Facility A amortizes quarterly; the New RMB term principal sits under fiscal 2031 where the prior schedule had fiscal 2030 and the loan table says October 2029; and the amortizing Hapoalim loan is labelled non-current.

anomalies.name: Quiet changes to prior-period text
anomalies.what: The Hapoalim modification proceeds and carrying-value increase differ from the prior filing with no correction flagged, the RTS closing date moved, and one restructuring figure is tagged to a full year in the 10-Q but nine months in the 10-K. No tagged value was re-reported differently.

anomalies.name: Repeated tagging errors
anomalies.what: The prior quarterly report tagged financing-cost amortization above the facility's face amount; RMB facility amounts carry identical rand and dollar values; Hapoalim carrying amounts carry a shekel unit; one compensation figure sits under three award types; software and intangibles were re-tagged between the 10-K and the 10-Q.

anomalies.name: Stale and inconsistent note text
anomalies.what: The EPS note still names preferred stock as the participating security after its redemption in April 2024; a performance-award fair value changes with no activity rows; Hapoalim distribution, prepayment and amortization terms were dropped without saying whether they still apply.

anomalies.name: Disclosures dropped without resolution
anomalies.what: The Pointer Brazil tax notice, with a remaining claim and a pending state appeal, is no longer disclosed and no resolution is stated; the restructuring policy added in the September 2025 quarter was removed.

anomalies.name: Director-affiliate warrant vests before issue
anomalies.name_ko: 발행 전부터 가득되는 이사 관계사 워런트
anomalies.what: A warrant issued to an affiliate of director Andrew Martin in lieu of his equity pay is dated April 2025 but vests in quarterly installments from June 2024; related-party pay outside the plan with a vesting start before the grant is unexplained.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP change tied to SEC guidance
anomalies.what: The release ties the adjusted EBITDA change to a detailed review of SEC guidance while the 10-Q says only further review; no comment letter is in the input, so whether the staff prompted it is unknown.

anomalies.name: Operating cash flow nearly doubled overstates
anomalies.name_ko: 영업현금흐름 거의 두 배 표현 과장
anomalies.what: The CEO says operating cash flow nearly doubled; computed growth is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}, matching the highlight bullet and short of a doubling. The direction is right; the characterization overstates it.

anomalies.name: South African decline against a rising Africa line
anomalies.name_ko: 남아공 매출 감소 설명과 아프리카 매출 증가
anomalies.what: The release says South African revenue was lower because of the reprioritization without naming a baseline; the 10-Q has no South-Africa-only line and its Africa revenue rose year over year, helped by RTS and currency. Against a projection nothing filed can test it; on a year-over-year reading the nearest line moved the other way.

anomalies.name: Reprioritization absent from the 10-Q
anomalies.what: The release describes reallocating South African resources, forgoing non-strategic revenue and revising guidance; the 10-Q's changed MD&A and notes never mention it, while the same 10-Q finds no impairment indicator and attributes the product decline to shipment timing.

anomalies.name: Production issue framed differently
anomalies.what: The 10-Q expects resolution during the September 2026 quarter with no assurance and no amount; the release calls the problem identified, solved, discrete and sized, and says some next-quarter revenue may shift a further quarter.

anomalies.name: Capitalized R&D does not bridge to software payments
anomalies.what: The release's capitalized research and development for the quarter differs from the tagged cash paid to develop software, and no capitalized additions are tagged, so accrual, non-cash capitalization or scope differences are not shown.

anomalies.name: Other non-cash items sign reversed in MD&A
anomalies.what: MD&A lists other non-cash items among amounts added back to reach operating cash flow, while the release's cash-flow statement prints the line in parentheses, a deduction, in both quarters.

anomalies.name: MD&A payables increase against a falling balance
anomalies.what: MD&A says accounts payable increased by the amount of the combined payables, accrued expenses and other liabilities line, while the accounts payable balance fell over the quarter.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP sales and marketing above GAAP
anomalies.what: The release's non-GAAP sales and marketing expense is larger than the tagged segment figure in both quarters, though a non-GAAP expense normally removes items; no bridge is shown.

anomalies.name: Net loss guidance below the first quarter's loss
anomalies.name_ko: 연간 순손실 가이던스가 첫 분기 손실보다 작음
anomalies.what: Full-year fiscal 2027 net loss guidance tops out below the first quarter's net loss of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, so it needs net income in the remaining quarters; every quarter in the calculator's series is a loss.

anomalies.name: Calculator total debt above the release
anomalies.what: The calculator's total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt} adds current maturities to a short-term borrowings line that, per the numbers reader, already includes them, and lands above the release's total and the 10-Q carrying amount; net debt {ratios.solvency.net_debt} and debt over EBITDA {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda} inherit it.

anomalies.name: Revolver draw against falling short-term loans
anomalies.what: MD&A says the new RMB revolvers were drawn during the quarter, but short-term bank loans fell over the quarter and net short-term debt cash flow was an outflow; the revolver balance is not separately tagged.

anomalies.name: Component transition against an unmeasured reserve
anomalies.what: Inventory days are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the lowest of six quarters, and raw materials fell, but MD&A describes component transitions with firmware incompatibility that can strand older parts while no reserve ratio exists for any recent period.

anomalies.name: Growing dependence on one government customer, untagged
anomalies.name_ko: 단일 정부 고객 의존 확대, 미측정
anomalies.what: Concentration facts are empty, yet the release describes the National Treasury deployment growing into a large share of new recurring revenue while other South African revenue is forgone to serve it; the filing does not measure the dependence.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}이 순손실 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}보다 커서 발생액이 음수({earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct})이고 이익이 현금보다 더 크게 움직여(평탄도 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}) 이익을 매끄럽게 만든 흔적은 없습니다. 다만 인수한 계약자산 회수액이 영업현금흐름에 들어 있고 소프트웨어 개발 지출이 빠져 있어 단순 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}은 실제보다 좋아 보이며, 그 금액은 계산기에 없습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 이번 분기 매출채권 회수일수 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일은 여섯 분기 중 두 번째로 높고, 결제 조건 문장이 삭제되었으며 매출 인식 시점 문구가 더 이른 쪽으로 바뀌었습니다. 그러나 계약부채 비율이 최고치({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct})이고 제품 매출이 줄어 숫자상 매출을 앞당긴 증거는 없습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 보증충당금 비율이 여섯 분기 중 최저({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct})인데 같은 분기에 펌웨어 문제와 생산 지연이 보고되었고, 내용연수 범위가 공시 없이 길어졌으며 입력값 표기가 바뀐 파생상품 평가이익이 이익에 들어왔습니다. 대손충당금과 법인세는 이익을 부풀리지 않으며, 이 효과들의 금액은 계산기에 없습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 자산화되는 연구개발비는 늘고 비용 처리된 연구개발비는 줄었으며(최근 네 분기 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}), 매 분기 반복되는 구조조정 비용이 조정 항목으로 빠집니다. 무형성 자산 비중 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}은 안정적이고 조정 EBITDA 정의는 보수적으로 바뀌었습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 보이지 않지만, 주식보상비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}은 현금이 나가지 않아도 실제 비용입니다. RTS 인수는 자회사 지분으로 대가를 치러 인수 지출에 잡히지 않았고 매도자의 풋옵션이 남아 있으며, 보증과 담보 설명은 이번 공시에서 빠졌습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 과거 재무제표 신뢰 철회, 감사인 교체, 지연 제출 이력이 있고 이번 실적 발표와 함께 CFO가 교체되었습니다. 이번 10-Q에는 만기표 오류, 태그 오류, 낡은 주석 문구가 많아 재무보고 절차가 약하다는 신호이지만 중대한 취약점은 명시되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 보도자료의 영업현금흐름, 설비투자, 부채 총액은 10-Q와 일치하지만, 증가율 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}를 거의 두 배라고 표현했고 남아공 사업 재조정은 10-Q에 없습니다. 10-Q의 경영진 설명은 기타 비현금 항목의 부호와 매입채무 증감을 잘못 적었고, 계산기 총부채 {ratios.solvency.total_debt}는 유동성 장기부채를 두 번 더한 것으로 보입니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일은 여섯 분기 중 최저로 재고 누적이나 밀어내기 매출의 흔적은 없습니다. 고객 집중도와 구매 약정은 태그된 자료가 없어 측정할 수 없고, 남아공 재무부 계약에 대한 의존이 커지는 점은 지켜봐야 합니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
